Title: Tag out of operating envelope
Logic_Summary: A measured analog value breaches its normal operating band for its current operating mode (engineering limits where defined, else the P1-P99 percentile band from a validated clean window), sustained past a dwell threshold. Catches manipulated setpoints, spoofed actuator commands, and process upsets.

Title: Setpoint outside approved range
Logic_Summary: A setpoint is written outside its MOC-approved operating band. Direct attacker/insider intent signal (Oldsmar class). Setpoints are written, not drifted, so a single out-of-range write is the event.

Title: Frozen value / replay
Logic_Summary: An analog PV holds perfectly constant beyond its normal stall duration, or its variance collapses below its noise floor. Catches stuck/failed sensors and replayed/held values used to mask a manipulation on the reporting path.

Title: Impossible state combination
Logic_Summary: Two or more independent tags simultaneously report a physically impossible combination (e.g. pump OFF but downstream flow present). Indicates a spoofed reading, manipulated I/O image, or serious instrument fault. Cross-checks independent tags against a plant physical invariant.

Title: Historian vs live PLC value divergence
Logic_Summary: The same physical tag, collected independently through the normal control->HMI->historian path and via a direct read from the controller, disagree beyond sensor tolerance. Detects manipulation-of-view / spoofed reporting where the operator is shown a fabricated normal value (Stuxnet class).
